{{Top|leg}}
A '''Fence''' was an obstacle used in [[swoopchasing]]. Generally, a Fence was an upright vertical wall with few special features. Specific types of Fence included the [[Vertical]] and its counterpart, the [[Shift-Vertical]]. The Vertical required [[swoopchaser]]s to jump them, while the Shift-Vertical required riders to duck under it.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
